WITH RECURSIVE
category_scope AS ( SELECT id, space_id, 1 AS depth FROM kb_document_category WHERE id = #{filters.categoryId} UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.space_id, parent.depth + 1 FROM kb_document_category child JOIN category_scope parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id AND child.space_id = parent.space_id WHERE parent.depth < 8 ),
bm25 AS ( SELECT c.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pdb.score(c.id) DESC) AS rk FROM kb_doc_chunk c JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id
WHERE c.content ||| #{queryText} AND
ORDER BY pdb.score(c.id) DESC LIMIT #{candidates} )
, vec AS ( SELECT c.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector) AS rk FROM kb_doc_chunk c JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id
WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_profile_id = #{profileId} AND
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector LIMIT #{candidates} )
, fused AS ( SELECT id, SUM(1.0 / (60 + rk)) AS rrf FROM ( SELECT id, rk FROM bm25
UNION ALL SELECT id, rk FROM vec
) u GROUP BY id ) SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.doc_id AS doc_id, c.version_id AS version_id, v.version_no AS version_no, d.title AS doc_title, c.space_id AS space_id, c.security_level AS security_level, c.chunk_idx AS chunk_idx, c.content AS content, c.page_no AS page_no, c.heading_path AS heading_path, c.structure_type AS structure_type, c.source_line_start AS source_line_start, c.source_line_end AS source_line_end, c.source_char_start AS source_char_start, c.source_char_end AS source_char_end, c.source_locator AS source_locator, f.rrf AS score FROM fused f JOIN kb_doc_chunk c ON c.id = f.id JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id JOIN kb_document_version v ON v.id = c.version_id AND v.doc_id = c.doc_id ORDER BY f.rrf DESC LIMIT #{candidates}
